question: Simplify: (x + 7)²
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the algebraic identity: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

Here, a = x and b = 7.

(x + 7)² = x² + 2 × x × 7 + 7²

= x² + 14x + 49

**∴ The correct answer is x² + 14x + 49.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: (x + 7)²

Expanding the power by multiplying the term by itself:

⇒ (x + 7) × (x + 7)

⇒ x(x + 7) + 7(x + 7)

⇒ x² + 7x + 7x + 49

⇒ x² + 14x + 49

**∴ The correct answer is x² + 14x + 49.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square of Difference Identity

The formula for the square of a subtraction is (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b².

Difference of Two Squares

Multiplying the sum and difference of two terms results in (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b².

Square of a Trinomial

The expansion for three terms is (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca.
